title: CryptoKit: HMAC Signatures & AES-GCM
hints: Seal with `AES.GCM.seal`, tamper with `combined`, then `AES.GCM.open` fails.
jsBridge: CryptoKit gives HMAC signatures, AES-GCM encryption and HKDF key derivation with safe defaults, the Swift counterpart of Node's `crypto` or WebCrypto, with a typed API (`SymmetricKey`, `SealedBox`).
